item.title: Platform Engineering in the AI Era: Building Engineering Leverage
item.description: In my previous article in the Engineering Leadership Playbook, I wrote about engineering budgets in the AI era. The central idea was simple: Don’t optimize engineering for lower cost. Optimize it for greater human leverage. AI should not simply become a reason to ask, “How many engineers can we reduce?”, rather we ask: “How can we make every engineer more capable?” That naturally leads to the next question: Where do we create that leverage?

item.title: Engineering Budget Planning in the AI Era
Engineering Leadership Playbook (ELP)
item.description: Over the last two decades, I have had the privilege of working across software development, consulting, architecture, product engineering, IoT, XR, AI, web3, metaverse, embedded systems, and enterprise modernization. During this journey, I have worked with small incubator team of a few engineers, or enterprise projects with 100s of engineers, consulting organizations, product companies, and engineering teams spread across multiple countries. One observation has remained remarkably consistent. Organizations rarely struggle because of technology.
